[SWS_ANM_00070]
⌈
The Repeat Message State of Network Mode is en-
tered from Bus-Sleep Mode or Prepare-Bus-Sleep Mode by default, when a network
(channel/PNC/VLAN) is requested by setting the value of NetworkRequestedState to
true and the NM module shall transmit a NM message immediately.
⌋
